annotation.title_clean: Decision (EU) 2016/1145 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 6 July 2016 on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund (application from Belgium — EGF/2015/012 BE/Hainaut Machinery)
annotation.title_en: Decision (EU) 2016/1145 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 6 July 2016 on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund (application from Belgium — EGF/2015/012 BE/Hainaut Machinery)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU decision mobilising EUR 1,824,041 from the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Belgium, supporting workers made redundant in machinery manufacturing in Hainaut, including 300 NEETs. Unrelated to AI or robotics; "machinery" appears only as an industrial sector name.
key_provisions_or_claims: Mobilises EUR 1,824,041 from the EGF for the 2016 EU budget
Responds to Belgian application EGF/2015/012 for Hainaut machinery redundancies
Co-finances personalised services also for 300 young NEETs
Enters into force on publication and applies from 6 July 2016
